request: Revise the layout-specific TV-unit visual by removing the tall TV-unit cabinet next to the puja and the corresponding low-console segment, creating a clear standing zone for one person at the puja. Add ceiling-height shallow storage above the TV feature at the same depth as the TV unit.

Remove all TV-unit vertical storage and lower console immediately beside the puja, leaving a continuous clear floor zone of approximately 750-900 mm for one person to stand at the shrine. Add a closed shallow ceiling-high overhead cabinet above the fixed TV panel, matching the 250-300 mm TV-unit depth, with a bottom edge kept clear of the screen and service access retained.

A ceiling-high overhead cabinet must not carry the TV bracket and needs separate, accessible electrical/data routing and ventilation strategy.
The TV unit remains limited by W5 clearance and needs a measured shop drawing before fabrication.
validation_plan: Check that the tall cabinet and low console next to the puja are both removed and the floor area is visibly clear.
Check that the overhead storage is shallow, aligned to the TV-unit depth, and does not visually compromise TV clearance or bracket access.
Obtain independent concept QA; no baseline promotion is requested.

results: The puja-side tall cabinet and its matching lower-console segment are removed in the draft; a continuous clear floor zone is visible.

Confirm the actual puja standing width, door/tray operation, overhead anchors, W5 shutter swing, TV fixing and ventilation through a measured shop drawing.

open_next_actions: Preserve as withdrawn draft history; do not use for design or fabrication.
